title.zh: 倒數計時的不平等：末期癌症患者如何被「錯位」的時間剝奪選擇權
title.en: The Unequal Clock: How Terminal Illness Reveals Time as a Mechanism of Inequality

summary.zh: 時間對每個人看似公平，但對末期癌症患者而言，時間本身就是一道階梯——有人能從容安排餘生，有人卻被制度與病情的雙重節奏逼入絕境。這項發表於《美國社會學評論》的研究，追蹤九十六位末期癌症患者五年的田野調查，揭示了一個關鍵概念：「時間錯位」。所謂時間錯位，是指個人行動的節奏與制度所強加的時間框架之間的撕裂——當治療、工作、家庭與官僚系統的時鐘各自走速不同，患者便陷入無止境的協調困境。
summary.en: Time seems like the great equalizer—until you're running out of it. A new study in the American Sociological Review examines how terminal cancer patients navigate a landscape where time itself becomes a mechanism of stratification. Drawing on five years of fieldwork across nine cancer clinics and 196 in-depth interviews with 96 patients, the authors introduce the concept of 'temporal misalignment': the fracture between the rhythms of individual action and the institutional timelines that structure when and how action is possible.

keyArticle.title: Temporal Misalignment and Unequal Agency: What Terminal Cancer Patients Teach Us about Time and Inequality
